findings.problem: Idiota is used for both men and women (el idiota, la idiota), so marking it masculine only would teach learners to say el idiota about a woman.
findings.fix: grammar: gender m/f, article el / la (el idiota for a man, la idiota for a woman)

back.es: the idiot (a male idiot, or the general dictionary form)
back.example: Don't be an idiot, she loves you.

note: Idiota is also often an adjective (es muy idiota), but the noun card is fine as it stands.
